'''Penegelen''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="EGtW:AC" /> located in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] [[Penegelen system/Legends|of the same name]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was orbited by a spherical cloud of debris known as the [[Penegelen Shards]], which consisted of tumbling fragments of alloy, [[Stone/Legends|rock]], and flash frozen dirt. [[Scientist/Legends|Scientists]] believed that these shards once made up a shell which enclosed Penegelen. This shell was thought to have been a creation of an ancient [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestial]].<ref name="EGtW:AC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Penegelen was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however the sidebar that would have mentioned the star was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the star was later released in [[2013]] as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'', a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Jason Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="EGtW:AC" /> An update to the StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and Fry, placed the Penegelen system, and therefore Penegelen, in grid square L-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
